title: Quake (QuakeWorld)
project: q1.pieter.com by Pieter Levels, on the FTE QuakeWorld engine
summary: Online QuakeWorld deathmatch for up to 8 players on the Quake shareware maps, with a live player list and leaderboard.

title: Quake II
project: q2.pieter.com by Pieter Levels, on the FTE QuakeWorld engine
summary: Online Quake II deathmatch for up to 8 players in the browser, an unofficial preservation project.

title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein (multiplayer)
project: rtcw.pieter.com by Pieter Levels, running iortcw via Wwasm
summary: Online Return to Castle Wolfenstein multiplayer on the mp_beach map with a leaderboard; the first load downloads about 380 MB.

title: Quake III Arena
project: q3.pieter.com by Pieter Levels, running Q3JS by Luka Klacar
summary: Online Quake III Arena deathmatch on a public server, using the GPL ioquake3 engine and the official demo data.

title: Urban Terror
project: ut.pieter.com by Pieter Levels, on the ioUrbanTerror engine
summary: Online Urban Terror, the free tactical shooter by FrozenSand, on a public server; the first load downloads about 1.5 GB of game data.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
project: Halo CE Web by Mitchell Hynes, built from the halo-ce-universal decompilation
summary: The original Xbox Halo rebuilt from its decompilation, running the campaign and invite-link multiplayer from your own disc image.
needsFiles: An XISO disc image made from your own Xbox copy of Halo: Combat Evolved. The site hosts no game data.

title: Halo: Combat Evolved
project: HCEMobile by Trevor (@BanTrev), built from the Halo decompilation
summary: A phone-first web app of the decompiled Xbox Halo with touch controls, split screen, co-op and account-based matchmaking.
needsFiles: Your own Halo: Combat Evolved Xbox disc image (.iso or .xiso); its maps folder (about 1.8 GB) is copied into browser storage. Online play needs a free account on the site.

title: Diablo
project: Diablo Web by Nikita Maksimov (JohnImril), based on d07RiV's diabloweb
summary: Diablo in the browser, playing the free shareware demo or the full game from your own data file.
needsFiles: Optional: DIABDAT.MPQ from your own copy of Diablo for the full game. The shareware demo needs nothing.

title: Tweetcraft
summary: A Minecraft-style block building game with its own assets, where each world has a link and everyone who opens it plays together.

title: Minecraft Classic
summary: Mojang's free browser re-release of the 2009 Minecraft Classic creative mode, with invite-link multiplayer for up to 9 players.

title: Quake
summary: Single-player Quake that fetches the official shareware episode, runs the full game from your own files, or plays the open LibreQuake data with bots.
needsFiles: Optional: PAK1.PAK from your own copy for the full game, and a mission pack PAK renamed to PAK2.PAK for the expansions.

title: Quake II
summary: Quake II that fetches the official demo (first three levels) or runs the full game from your own files.
needsFiles: Optional: PAK0.PAK (and PAK1.PAK, PAK2.PAK) from your own copy for the full game.

title: DOOM
project: Dwasm by Gregory Maynard-Hoare (GMH-Code), based on PrBoom+
summary: Doom engine port that plays the shareware episode, Freedoom 1 and 2, HACX, Harmony and REKKR, or any IWAD you supply.
needsFiles: Optional: your own IWAD (for example DOOM.WAD or DOOM2.WAD) for the commercial games.

title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein
project: Wwasm by Gregory Maynard-Hoare (GMH-Code), based on iortcw
summary: Return to Castle Wolfenstein single player that fetches the official demo or runs the full game from your own files.
needsFiles: Optional: pak0.pk3, sp_pak1.pk3 and sp_pak2.pk3 from your own copy, plus the sp_pak3.pk3 and sp_pak4.pk3 patches, for the full game.

title: DOOM
summary: Shareware Doom with online multiplayer run over Cloudflare Workers; start a game and share its link, or play solo.

title: Diablo
summary: The original diabloweb port, playing the shareware demo or the full game from your own data file.
needsFiles: Optional: DIABDAT.MPQ from your own copy of Diablo for the full game. The shareware demo needs nothing.

title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2
summary: A fan-made web engine that recreates Red Alert 2 with the original maps and online multiplayer, using your own game files.
needsFiles: Files from your own Red Alert 2 install: ra2.mix, language.mix and multi.mix (Yuri's Revenge files optional).

title: Neverball
project: Neverball web build by the Neverball project
summary: Tilt the floor to roll a ball through each level, collecting coins before time runs out; includes replays and add-on upload.

title: Endless Sky
summary: The open-source space trading and combat game Endless Sky, with saves and plugins kept in the browser.

title: SuperTux
project: SuperTux web build by Semphris (SuperTux team)
summary: The open-source 2D platformer SuperTux in the browser; it can run slowly on weaker PCs.

title: Wolfenstein 3D
project: Iron Wolf by Michael Bohn (Rust rewrite of the engine)
summary: A Rust rewrite of the Wolfenstein 3D engine that plays the shareware episode, or all episodes from your own data files.
needsFiles: Optional: the data files from your own full version of Wolfenstein 3D for all episodes.

title: Doom 3 (demo)
summary: An experimental WebAssembly port of the id Tech 4 engine running the official Doom 3 demo, with a large first download.

title: BananaBread
project: BananaBread by Mozilla, on the Cube 2: Sauerbraten engine
original: Original game (Mozilla, 2012) on the Cube 2 engine
summary: Mozilla's 2012 first-person shooter demo built on the Cube 2: Sauerbraten engine, with five small levels against bots.

title: Luanti (Minetest)
summary: An experimental WebAssembly build of the open-source voxel engine; worlds are not saved and hosted servers live only while the page is open.

title: Celeste Classic
project: Maddy Thorson and Noel Berry (free release by the authors)
summary: The original PICO-8 version of Celeste, made in four days and published free by its creators.

title: Q1K3
summary: A small Quake-style shooter written in 13 KB for the js13k competition, with two levels.

title: HexGL
summary: A futuristic WebGL racing game in the style of WipEout, written in 2012.

title: Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup
project: DCSS WebTiles on the CBRO public server (game by the DCSS team)
summary: The open-source roguelike played with tiles on a public server; you need a free account on that server.

title: Pac-Man
project: Google Doodle, made with Namco for the 30th anniversary
summary: Google's licensed Pac-Man doodle from 2010, a recreation of the arcade game on a maze shaped like the Google logo.
